d:
"Mellaga Tellarindoi" video song from the movie Shatamanam Bhavati features Sharwanand and Anupama Parameswaran, with soulful music by Mickey J Meyer. This beautiful melody captures the essence of tradition and love with its soothing tune and heartfelt lyrics.
Song: Mellaga Tellarindoi
Movie Name : Shatamanam Bhavati
Banner : Sri Venkateswara Creations
Producer : Dil Raju
Director : Vegesna Satish
Music Director : Mickey J Meyer
Actor : Sharwanand
